name: quantumos
description: QuantumOS for Claude Code: the hub, one policy-gated MCP endpoint for the Kannaka constellation (allow / ask / deny per tool, every call in a ledger), fronting kannaka-memory, kannaka-quantum, Kannaktopus, the provider broker, 0xSCADA, the steward, kannaka-hdl, kannaka-apps, the Hive's buzz CLI, kannaka-lens, kannaka-cannon and kannaka-crystal; plus the QuantumOS kernel's own MCP (qos-mcp) when you want to boot the OS itself.
